# UX Checklist: Instalação e configuração (install-and-setup)

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade dos requisitos de experiência da 002 (tela de configuração da Steam, "Let the game
close", atualização) antes do plano
**Created**: 2026-11-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: Standard · Audience: Reviewer (PR)

## Tela de configuração

- [x] CHK001 Is the content of the setup screen listed (Steam, last-used account, game, launch option state, buttons)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified what the window shows while Steam is not set up, and how the user postpones? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are the states "Steam not found", "game not installed", "no account" and "already set up" each defined with what the user sees? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Is the in-progress feedback defined while Steam closes and reopens (up to 30 s)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK005 Are the failure messages defined for Steam not closing and Steam not reopening? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Is the success message specified? [Clarity, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK007 Is the content of "Details" specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK008 Is the disabled state with the game open specified, with its text? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]

## Deixar o jogo fechar

- [x] CHK009 Are the placement (status bar and tray menu) and the toggled labels of "Let the game close"/"Reconnect" consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §FR-016, §FR-031]
- [x] CHK010 Is the hint that the game's X only closes after "Let the game close" specified with its text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK011 Is the feedback for a failed "Reconnect" defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Is the visibility of the button without a game or without reading defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Atualização

- [x] CHK013 Is where "Update ready" and "Restart to update" appear specified, and their state with the game open? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK014 Is how a failed update check shows to the user specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025]

## Geral

- [x] CHK015 Is keyboard access defined for the new buttons? [Coverage, Spec §FR-034]
- [x] CHK016 Is the interface language stated (English), with final texts left to the builder? [Assumption, Spec §Deixado para quem construir]
- [x] CHK017 Are the success criteria for the user flows measurable (time to play, close time, reconnect time)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-003, §SC-004]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
